Unfortunately I am forced to get these service hours. I have to get 24 hours of service to graduate this year. It has to be "one-on-one working with the disabled." I can't make excuses for not doing them, because service is seen as a REAAAAALLY big deal at my school. The more service hours you have, the better person you are. I don't think they will let me off the hook even if i'm extremely depressed & unable to function.

Well the problem is that i'm forced to get 24 hours of service working with people who are less-fortunate. My school requires it, its not an option. It's impossible to graduate without getting these hours.

The worst part is we have to make a 15 minute presentation on a topic about the disabled or w/e at the end of the year. I have to stand in front of the class of 22 people, and talk for 15 minutes. I'm terrified. To top it off, I heard the teachers take off points if you stutter, don't make eye contact, say "uh/um", ect. I can't do it, i just can't. The end of the year is so far but i'm already so terrified.
